method: Read-only pinned source; no third-party runtime executed outside Docker. GitHub code searches for pap_dlg and poppy-session+jwt, first 30 results each, supplemented the known-project review. This is bounded discovery, not proof no other implementation exists.

peers.finding: Current Session-JWT wire; ten supported API-oriented demo scenarios. No MCP, conversations, streaming, handoff or browser join.
Earlier 0.3 wire: Session Keys and Session Tokens.
AUTH.md and INTEGRATIONS.md require Session Token, Session Key proof and old Session grants, despite the README saying 0.3.
AUTH.md creates a Session Key per start and stores Session Tokens in memory; earlier 0.3 wire.
